children: U.S. Director of Federal Housing Bill Pulte said on Thursday credit reporting agencies Equifax
have been overcharging Americans for a long period of time.

"Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion have been overcharging Americans for far too long. This will end soon. We are seriously considering bi-merge, and stronger solutions (SAFER and SOUNDER)," he wrote in a post on X.
